I went through all 78 rules in the checklist (mode `--review-pr`) against `e7d8ae856…HEAD`: 57 files, about 3.5k added lines, mostly the mobile WalletConnect transaction-request work. I found 8 rule problems and one bug that no rule covers; the bug is the most serious. No tracked files were changed. The only file I wrote is the temporary checklist at `docs/engineering/pr-self-review-checklist.generated.md`, with all 78 items ticked. It isn't gitignored, but it sits inside the untracked `docs/engineering/` folder.

## Findings (most severe first)

**1. Not covered by a rule, but it breaks an established repo pattern: `wallet_getCallsStatus` can keep returning the first status it saw** (`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/context/WalletKitProvider.tsx:330`)
- It calls `transactionsGetTransactionByIdV1.initiate({ chainId, id })` without `{ forceRefetch: true }` and never releases the subscription.
- RTK Query's default is `refetchOnMountOrArgChange: false`, and nothing in the repo overrides it. So when a dApp polls, every call after the first gets the cached result.
- Result: a bundle first reported as pending (100) is likely to stay pending (100) after it executes.
- The two existing callers of this same endpoint both pass `forceRefetch: true`: `apps/mobile/src/services/tx/fetchTransactionDetails.ts:13` and `apps/mobile/src/store/middleware/pendingTxs.ts:110`.
- No test covers this provider callback.

**2. CODE-06 (unhandled async): the session-request handler has no top-level catch** (`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/hooks/useSessionRequestHandler.ts:47`, `:111`)
- `handleRequest` is an async event listener that awaits `routeSessionRequest` with no `try/catch` around it.
- Any error inside the router becomes an unhandled promise rejection, and the dApp never gets a reply.
- One concrete trigger is in `methodRouter.ts:111`: `(rpc.params as unknown[]) ?? []` doesn't check for an array. If a dApp sends an object instead, the array destructuring at `:145`, `:163`, `:184` and `:197` throws.
- Fix: wrap the handler body and answer with -32603 (internal error), or have the router check for an array first.

**3. TX-04 (synchronous double-submit guard): Review is guarded only by React state** (`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/hooks/useSendTransaction.ts:68-72`, `RequestSheetHost.tsx:187`)
- The button disables through `composing` state, which only applies after a re-render. Two quick taps can each compose a draft, set an outstanding request and push `/confirm-transaction`.
- The same PR already uses a `useRef` guard in `HeaderQrButton.tsx`; the same approach fits here.

**4. PKG-01 (shared package vs app copy): `stripEip155Prefix` now exists twice**
- The new copy is at `packages/utils/src/features/walletconnect/utils.ts:19`. The web app still has an identical copy at `apps/web/src/features/walletconnect/services/utils.ts:8`, which it exports and uses in two places.
- Web should re-export the package version, as that file already does for `getEip155ChainId` and `isPairingUri`.

**5. PKG-01 / DRY: web's EIP-5792 status logic is copied into mobile** (`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/services/getCallsStatus.ts:42`)
- `mapTxStatus` and the envelope builder say they are "verbatim from web" (`apps/web/src/services/safe-wallet-provider/index.ts:102-111`, `:454`).
- `packages/utils/src/features/walletconnect/eip5792.ts` already holds shared 5792 code (`buildAtomicCapabilities`), so this logic belongs there rather than as a second copy.

**6. NUM-02 (converting external strings to numbers): unchecked `parseInt` in `wallet_switchEthereumChain`** (`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/services/methodRouter.ts:149`)
- `String(parseInt(target.chainId, 16))` turns malformed input into `'NaN'`, or quietly accepts a partial value (`'0x1g'` becomes `1`).
- Bad input then comes back as error 4901 ("not deployed on this chain") instead of -32602 (invalid params).
- It should parse with `BigInt` inside a `try/catch`, the same way the `wallet_sendCalls` chainId check already does.

**7. TEST-02 (new branches need their own tests): the provider's new gating logic is untested** (`WalletKitProvider.tsx:299`, `:323`)
- In `switchActiveChainByCaip2`, neither gate (chain config missing, Safe not deployed on the target chain) is tested. The router tests replace the whole function with a mock.
- In `getCallsStatus`, none of the branches are tested: tx not found, receipt fetch failure, no chain config, and the success case.
- Adding the success test would also have caught finding 1.

**8. UI-01 / mobile AGENTS.md (use theme tokens): hard-coded style values in new UI**
- `apps/mobile/src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:51` has `shadowColor="#000"`.
- `apps/mobile/src/features/Share/components/ShareView.tsx:47` has `paddingTop={30} paddingLeft={20}` where a Tamagui spacing token fits, and `:61` has `maxWidth={260}`.
- Low severity: raw `fontSize` and `borderRadius` numbers are common elsewhere in mobile.

**9. UX-01 (long text in tight spaces): dApp-supplied text has no truncation**
- dApp names and domains render with no `numberOfLines` or ellipsis: `DappIdentity.tsx:68` (name), `:85` (domain pill next to the info icon), and `TransactionHeader.tsx:69` (dApp name as the header title).
- A long name or host can wrap badly or push the info icon out of the pill.

**Also worth confirming (PROD-01, visible product change):** `ShareView.tsx` removes the "This account is only available on …" line and the horizontal padding. `ShareView` is also the home Receive screen, so this changes that screen as well as the new My code tab. Please confirm the design intent covers both.

## Rules that applied and passed
- **API-01:** the `chainIdToHex` switch to `BigInt` has no other callers, and `getAvailableChainsNames` was deleted along with all its uses.
- **Safe-switch rejection:** DATA-05 (`sameAddress` is used), RTK-01 (`unwrap`, and preview results are inspected), and CHAIN-01 (CreateCall comes from deployment data).
- **Mobile layout and structure:** MOB-04 (the `_layout.tsx` change is structural only), the mobile structure guide's hidden-tab `pointerEvents` gating in ScanConnect, and STATE-02.
- **Tests:** TEST-01, TEST-03 and TEST-04, with good router and service coverage otherwise.

## Other notes
- I didn't need to look up the review history behind any rule.
- The root AGENTS.md says to treat code comments as tech debt. This diff is very heavily commented (`methodRouter.ts`, `WalletKitProvider.tsx`), so it may be worth trimming. It's not a rule failure.
- None of these findings were fixed, since this was a review-only run.
